leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a Node.js module that exports a masking function
Implement a configuration object to define PII patterns and replacement rules
Apply regular expressions to identify sensitive data patterns in log strings
Manipulate string data by replacing PII with masked placeholders
Integrate the masking utility into a logging function
Control the masking behavior through configurable options
Initialize and test the utility with sample log data containing various PII types
lessonTitle: Build PII masking utility for logs
